routing.title: Routing Builder — IMSEL Tools
routing.desc: Visual routing profile builder for IMSEL VPN. Configure rules, DNS and geo files — get an imsel://routing/ link and a QR code.
routing.heading: Routing Builder
routing.lead: // Visual editor for IMSEL VPN routing profiles
routing.importHint: Paste a link (imsel://routing/…, any scheme with host routing), Base64 or JSON
routing.linkSourceHint: Only the URL is included, not the profile below. The site does not fetch it. The app checks public addresses, redirects, TLS and profile validity. Autorouting defaults to 24 hours; local 0/12/24/72/168-hour settings are separate from GEO updates. URLs may contain secrets: share carefully. This does not start a VPN connection.
routing.linkSourceInvalid: Enter an absolute HTTP(S) URL without credentials, fragments, whitespace or an invalid port.
routing.onaddHint: Use onadd to select the imported profile. For subscription commands, selection affects only that subscription, never the app-wide profile. This does not connect the VPN.
routing.qrTooLong: The link is too long for a QR code — share it as text.
routing.advancedNotice: Edit full Rules using rule cards and Outbounds in the destinations tab. With Rules present, the six simple lists are not used. DNS, default destination and category order remain independent. With explicit Outbounds, configure direct resolution in the freedom destination itself. Preserving parameters does not test connectivity.
routing.templateHint: This button replaces the current draft. The standard profile includes UDP DNS, local networks and an explicit all-ports proxy rule. To proxy only selected traffic, disable that broad rule and select direct as the default destination.
routing.fallbackProxy: Remaining traffic → dynamic proxy for the selected connection. Explicit rules match first. In the template this is the first outbound; custom JSON receives a final network: tcp,udp rule. Create an editable all-traffic rule using rule cards.
routing.fallbackDirect: Remaining traffic → direct. An explicit broad proxy rule may still match all traffic: disable it separately. In the template direct becomes the first outbound; custom JSON receives a final network: tcp,udp rule.
routing.blockAdsDesc: Profile exchange flag. This alone does not add ad-blocking rules; configure those explicitly.
routing.geoIntervalLabel: Geo database automatic update interval, hours
routing.geoIntervalHint: 0 disables updates; 1–8760 sets the interval. Blank omits the setting. Editing a checksum URL to blank explicitly clears it.
routing.geoFieldsInvalid: Check HTTP(S) URLs without credentials or fragments and an interval from 0 to 8760. Link and preview are hidden until corrected.
routing.ruleEditorHint: Different condition fields match together (AND); values within one field are alternatives. Enter one list value per line. For all TCP/UDP traffic, select tcp,udp with no other conditions. Keep-on-reset preserves a rule during reset but does not prevent editing.
routing.ruleOrderHint: Evaluation order: DNS → categories in the selected order → custom destinations. Move up/down changes order only within the same action.
routing.ruleInvalid: Check rules: enabled rules need at least one condition and the destination must exist. Invalid drafts are not included in links or previews.
routing.ruleEmpty: The full list is empty: simple lists do not apply; the default destination is used.
routing.simpleRulesHint: Used only without Rules. Explicit conversion preserves values as separate full rules. There is no automatic reverse conversion.
routing.outboundHint: proxy represents the selected connection and cannot be created here. Add direct, block, DNS or additional destinations. Tags must be unique. A destination referenced by rules or chains cannot be removed or renamed before its dependencies are fixed. Data is processed only in your browser.
routing.outboundEmpty: The full destination list is empty. direct and block are not added automatically.
routing.outboundInvalid: Check JSON objects, unique tags, references and cycles. Invalid drafts are not included in links or previews.
routing.outboundProtected: A rule or another destination references this destination, or it is direct by default. Update dependencies first.
routing.routeOrderDesc: Category processing order: block / proxy / direct
routing.domainStrategyDesc: Domain resolution strategy: none / AsIs / IPIfNonMatch / IPOnDemand
routing.fakeDnsDesc: Virtual addresses and DNS interception. Not required for UDP, TCP or DoH; compatible sniffing is required.
routing.useChunkFilesDesc: Trimmed geo files to save memory
routing.dnsServersLead: DoH is optional. Enable or disable each server, add your own addresses and change their order. Editing the list saves DnsServers; legacy Remote/Domestic fields no longer determine this profile's DNS.
routing.dnsLocalFallback: The app always appends system DNS (localhost), and prepends fakedns when FakeDNS is enabled. Disabling or removing every server leaves system DNS. It does not disable DNS entirely. System DNS may take priority for local domains rather than always being tried last.
routing.dnsPortHint: UDP uses the separate port field (default 53). For TCP, DoH and DoQ, put a nonstandard port in the URL. DoH typically uses 443 and DoQ 853. An imported separate port is preserved until you explicitly change the transport.
routing.dnsDomainsHint: One per line: domain:example.org, full:example.org or geosite:category. This prioritizes a DNS server; it does not proxy traffic.
routing.dnsLocalHint: Local and system modes connect directly, bypassing routing rules. DNS queries may be exposed to your local network or provider.
routing.dnsRoutedHint: Queries follow routing rules. The server name does not force proxy routing. Domain-based resolver addresses may need a DnsHosts entry to avoid a resolution loop.
routing.dnsCustomHint: Custom addresses are preserved without substitution. Core compatibility is not verified; DoT (tls://) is unsupported by the pinned core.
routing.dnsEmpty: No custom DNS servers. System DNS will be used; FakeDNS is added separately when enabled.
routing.dnsEditorInvalid: Check DNS addresses and ports: a nonempty address without whitespace and a port from 1 to 65535 are required. Link, QR and preview are hidden until corrected; the profile JSON retains the last valid values. URLs must use a supported scheme without credentials or fragments.
routing.dnsSupportedScope: The editor supports profile fields address, port, domains, enabled and global QueryStrategy. Exchanging the list and disabled entries requires an app version supporting DnsServers. Core options such as skipFallback, expectedIPs, clientIp and disableCache cannot be exchanged in this profile format. Appending localhost does not guarantee protection from DNS leaks. Do not add fakedns as an ordinary server: use the separate FakeDNS switch.
routing.dnsHostsDesc: JSON object "domain → IP" for DNS overrides
routing.dnsHostsInvalid: DnsHosts: expected a JSON object like {"domain": "IP"}
routing.geoipDesc: Link to the geoip.dat file (empty — the app's own file is used)
routing.geositeDesc: Link to the geosite.dat file (empty — the app's own file is used)
routing.lastUpdatedDesc: Unix timestamp of the last geo file update (optional)
routing.rulesLead: Rule categories: direct, proxy and block — for sites and IPs.
routing.directSitesDesc: Sites that will use a direct connection
routing.directIpDesc: IP addresses and CIDRs for a direct connection
routing.proxyIpDesc: IP addresses and CIDRs to proxy
routing.geoMismatch: This catalog was prepared from the Loyalsoldier download URLs. The profile uses another source or the app's own database: category availability is unverified. Selecting categories will not change the database source.
routing.geoSearchHint: For example: telegram, youtube, ru, private
routing.geoEmpty: No categories found. You can still add a custom value manually.
routing.geoAddHint: Existing categories are checked. Manual rules are preserved.
routing.previewLead: Apply the current profile to a demonstration template or your connection JSON.
routing.previewDisclaimer: This previews routing and DNS, not the exact configuration launched by the app. It does not verify server connectivity, geo database contents or core compatibility of every option. Applying a profile to ready-made JSON in the app requires separate permission. The source JSON is not modified or stored by the site.
routing.previewTemplateNote: The template uses the nonexistent server proxy.example.invalid. This demonstrates the structure and is not a working connection.
routing.previewReplace: The preview replaces DNS and ordinary routing rules with the profile and adds a fallback for remaining TCP/UDP traffic. Connection details and other sections are preserved. Complex chains, balancers and service routing are unsupported: an error is shown instead of a partial result. Your JSON sniffing is not changed automatically.
routing.previewInput: Source connection JSON (processed only in your browser)
routing.previewPending: Apply the profile JSON changes or fix DNS servers and DnsHosts first. The stale preview has been hidden.
routing.previewInvalidBase: Enter a valid connection JSON object with a nonempty outbounds list and unique tags.
routing.previewSelectProxy: Select a proxy outbound from the source JSON.
routing.previewUnsupported: This connection structure is unsupported by the preview. FakeDNS requires compatible SOCKS inbounds with fakedns sniffing enabled. The source configuration is unchanged.
routing.previewInvalidTarget: Rule destinations cannot be resolved. Check tags, Outbounds, custom destinations and conflicts.
routing.previewInvalidDns: DNS cannot be built. Check server addresses and ports.
routing.previewInvalidProfile: A preview cannot be built for these profile settings.
routing.jsonLead: // Edit the profile JSON directly, with synchronization
routing.errInvalidLink: Invalid routing/autorouting link or source URL. Queries are allowed only inside a source HTTP(S) URL; credentials and fragments are not allowed.
routing.errUnsupportedScheme: http(s) links are not routing profiles
routing.errMissingPayload: The link has no profile payload
routing.errUnsupportedCommand: The off command is not supported for import
routing.errInvalidBase64: Invalid Base64 in the link payload
routing.errInvalidJson: The payload is not a profile JSON object
routing.errInvalidProfile: Invalid profile fields or graph. Check unique nonreserved outbound tags, existing rule/detour targets, cycles, conflicting detours and nonempty enabled rule conditions. Also check DNS field types, QueryStrategy and boolean BlockAds. Validation is not a server connectivity test.
routing.errBadInput: Unrecognized input: expected a link, Base64 or JSON

deeplink.title: Deep Link Generator — IMSEL Tools
deeplink.desc: IMSEL VPN command link reference and deep link analyzer: routing profiles, offline subscription shares.
deeplink.heading: Deep Link Generator
deeplink.lead: // IMSEL VPN command links: reference and analyzer
deeplink.routingAddDesc: Add a routing profile. An existing profile with the same name is overwritten.
deeplink.routingOnaddDesc: Add a profile and activate it immediately. Built in the Routing builder.
deeplink.routingBareDesc: The command before the payload is optional. Any scheme except http(s) works: only imsel:// opens the app automatically; other links are imported inside the app from the clipboard or by QR code.
deeplink.subEncDesc: Encrypted offline subscription share. Created by the app when exporting.
deeplink.subPlainDesc: Plain offline subscription share. Created by the app when exporting.
deeplink.analyzerHint: Paste any link — the tool identifies its type and shows the contents
